scripts.d1:init: cd frontend && npx wrangler d1 create veneth-studio
scripts.d1:local: cd frontend && npx wrangler d1 execute veneth-studio --local --file=./src/db/schema.sql
scripts.d1:deploy: cd frontend && npx wrangler d1 execute veneth-studio --remote --file=./src/db/schema.sql
scripts.d1:studio: cd frontend && npx wrangler d1 studio veneth-studio
scripts.r2:init: cd frontend && npx wrangler r2 bucket create veneth-assets
scripts.pages:dev: cd frontend && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.pages:deploy: cd frontend && npx wrangler pages deploy dist
